column1: # Columns, separated by a TAB:  context <TAB> English source text <TAB> translation
#   context  usually empty. `@plural`, `@id` and `@msg` mean something to the apps; any other
#            word is a label that tells apart two meanings of the same English.
#   escapes  \n  \t  \\  inside a column. `{name}` placeholders must appear in both columns (in any
#            order), and a trailing "…" in one needs one in the other.
#   @plural  English `one|other`; the translation lists this language's plural forms, `|`-separated.
#   Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored. A missing entry shows in English.
# Clean room: every entry was written from the plain meaning of the English text in ordinary
# computing vocabulary. No other product's localisation, string table or translated UI was
# consulted or copied; add entries the same way.

column3: Lo sapevate che si può trascinare un intero progetto come file zip sulla pagina iniziale? Diventa un nuovo progetto.

column2: Double-click a place in the PDF to go to the line that wrote it. Edit › Show in PDF goes the other way.
column3: Fare doppio clic su un punto del PDF per andare alla riga che lo ha scritto. Modifica › Mostra nel PDF fa il percorso inverso.

column2: Drop an image file on the formatted view, and it becomes a figure with a caption.

column2: Edit › Find in Project searches, and replaces, in every file of the project.

column2: Edit › Go to File… lists the project's files as you type, the ones you opened last first.
column3: Modifica › Vai al file… elenca i file del progetto mentre si digita, prima quelli aperti più di recente.

column2: Edit › Quick Fix lists the fixes for the error at the caret, such as adding the package a command needs.

column2: Every save that changes something is a version. The History section says what each one changed and can restore any of them.
column3: Ogni salvataggio che cambia qualcosa è una versione. La sezione Cronologia dice cosa ha cambiato ciascuna e può ripristinarne qualsiasi.

column2: Every shortcut can be changed: Keyboard Shortcuts, at the bottom of the rail, lists them all.
column3: Ogni scorciatoia si può cambiare: Scorciatoie da tastiera, in fondo alla barra delle sezioni, le elenca tutte.

column2: Export, in the PDF's toolbar, saves your document as a DOCX or OpenDocument text, a web page or Markdown, and beamer slides as a PPTX presentation.

column2: F12 on a reference or a command goes to where it is defined, even in another file.
column3: F12 su un riferimento o un comando va dove è definito, anche in un altro file.

column2: F6 moves the keyboard between the regions of the window: the menus, the rail, the side panel, the editor and the PDF.

column2: F7 goes to the next spelling or grammar problem in the file.

column2: When a document needs a LaTeX package your TeX Live lacks. Download automatically: during the build, from TeX Live's own repository for the year of your TeX Live, so it matches the rest (needs the network). Install them myself: the build's message names the package and how to install it. Don't download: the build stops at the missing package.

Li installo io: il messaggio della compilazione indica il pacchetto e come installarlo. Non scaricare: la compilazione si ferma al pacchetto mancante.
